# Chart of Accounts (Cin7 Core API v2)

Group `Chart of Accounts` of the Cin7 Core API reference. Base URL `https://inventory.dearsystems.com/ExternalApi/v2/`; every request carries the `api-auth-accountid` and `api-auth-applicationkey` headers (see `../api-basics.md`). 4 actions on 1 resources, 1 field tables.

| Action | Path |
|---|---|
| [GET](#get-ref-account) | `GET /ref/account?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&Code={Code}&Name={Name}&Type={Type}&Status={Status}` |
| [POST](#post-ref-account) | `POST /ref/account` |
| [PUT](#put-ref-account) | `PUT /ref/account` |
| [DELETE](#delete-ref-account) | `DELETE /ref/account?Code={Code}` |


Chart of Accounts CRUD operations

### Available Fields for Chart of Accounts
| Property | Type           | Length | Required | Notes          |
|:---------|----------------|--------|----------|----------------|
| `Code`   | String         | 50     | Yes      | Unique code of Account   |
| `Name`   | String         | 256    | Yes      | Account name   |
| `Type`   | String         | 50     | Yes      | Should be one of the following values: `BANK`, `CURRLIAB`, `LIABILITY`, `TERMLIA`, `PAYGLIABILITY`, `SUPERANNUATIONLIABILITY`, `WAGESPAYABLELIABILITY` |
| `Status` | String         | 50     | Yes      | Account status |
| `Description` | String    |        |          | Account description |
| `Class`  | String         |        |          | Should be one of the following values: `ASSET`, `LIABILITY`, `EXPENSE`, `EQUITY`, `REVENUE` |
| `SystemAccount` | String  |        |          | Read-only for PUT. Should be one of the following values: `Accounts receivable`, `Accounts payable`, `Bank revaluations`, `GST / VAT`, `GST on imports`, `Historical adjustment`, `Realized currency gains`, `Retained earnings`, `Rounding`, `Tracking transfers`, `Unpaid expense claims`, `Unrealized currency gains`, `Wages payable`". For POST requests, the user may optionally provide a value for either SystemAccount or SystemAccountCode. If both fields are provided, the account code and name must correspond to the same account. |
| `SystemAccountCode` | String  |        |          | Read-only for PUT. Should be one of the following values: `BANKCURRENCYGAIN`, `CREDITORS`, `DEBTORS`, `GST`, `GSTONIMPORTS`, `HISTORICAL`, `REALISEDCURRENCYGAIN`, `RETAINEDEARNINGS`, `ROUNDING`, `TRACKINGTRANSFERS`, `UNPAIDEXPCLM`, `UNREALISEDCURRENCYGAIN`, `WAGEPAYABLES`". For POST requests, the user may optionally provide a value for either SystemAccount or SystemAccountCode. If both fields are provided, the account code and name must correspond to the same account. |
| `ForPayments` | String    |        |          | Account status |
| `DisplayName` | String    |        |          | Account display name. Read-only. |
| `OldCode`     | String    |        |          | Read-only.     |
| `Bank`        | String    |        |          | Name of the Bank. Only for PUT and POST. Required if Account `Type` is `BANK`. |
| `BankAccountNumber` | String |     |          | Bank Account Number. Only for PUT and POST. Required if Account `Type` is `BANK`. |
| `BankAccountId` | Guid    |        |          | Bank Account ID to which the Account is linked. Read-only  |
| `Currency`     | String   |        |          | Currency. Read-only.     |

## Chart of Accounts

Path: `/ref/account`

<a id="get-ref-account"></a>
### GET /ref/account?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&Code={Code}&Name={Name}&Type={Type}&Status={Status}

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page
  - default: 1
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100.
  - default: 100
- `Code` (optional, string): Only return accounts with the specific code
- `Name` (optional, string): Only return accounts that start with the specific name
- `Type` (optional, string): Only return accounts with the specific type
- `Status` (optional, string): Only return accounts with the specific status

<a id="post-ref-account"></a>
### POST /ref/account

Request body:

```json
{
  "Code": "001",
  "Status": "ACTIVE",
  "Name": "Accounts Payable test",
  "Type": "CURRLIAB",
  "Description": "Outstanding invoices the company has received from suppliers but has not yet paid at balance date",
  "Class": "LIABILITY",
  "SystemAccount": "Accounts payable",
  "SystemAccountCode": "CREDITORS"
}
```

```json
}
```

<a id="put-ref-account"></a>
### PUT /ref/account
+ Updating accounts is not allowed while integration with Xero or Quickbooks enabled.

Request body:

```json
{
  "Code": "001",
  "Status": "ACTIVE",
  "Name": "Accounts Payable put test",
  "Type": "CURRLIAB",
  "Description": "Put test description",
  "Class": "LIABILITY"
}
```

Response 200:

```json

  "Total": 1,
  "Page": 1,
  "AccountsList": [
    {
      "Code": "001",

}
```
